diary: Mr. Krabs yelled at me in front of everyone because the fryer broke. I said nothing and kept flipping. On the bus home I hummed the lullaby grandma used to sing.
wants: someone to say it was not my fault
fears: that I am bad at my job
past_dream: Last week I dreamed grandma's porch was full of fog and I could hear her singing but could not find the door.

facts.text: His grandma sang him a lullaby when he could not sleep.
Last week's dream: fog on grandma's porch, her voice, no door.
He goes silent when someone raises their voice.
